resources.name: Okta - SSO - Management Activity Spike in a Short Period of Time
resources.description:
This rule detects an abnormal volume of management or administrative activities occurring on the management plane of Okta.
While some level of management activity is expected in normal operations, this detection aims to identify significant deviations from the established baseline.
This could indicate potential unauthorized access, or misuse of privileges.

search.filter:
defineTable(
    query={
        #Vendor="okta" #event.module="sso" #repo!="xdr*"
        | #event.kind="event" #event.outcome="success"
        | array:contains(array="event.category[]", value="configuration")
        | bucket(field="user.name", span=1h, function=count(as=hourly_event_count), limit=500)
        | hourly_event_count>0
        | groupBy([user.name], function=[avg(hourly_event_count, as=hourly_average_event_count),stdDev(hourly_event_count, as=hourly_stddev_event_count)])
    }, 
    include=[*], 
    name="admin_event_stats",
    start=7d,
    end=1h)
    | #Vendor="okta" #event.module="sso" #repo!="xdr*"
    | #event.kind="event" #event.outcome="success"
    | array:contains(array="event.category[]", value="configuration")
    | groupBy([user.name], function=[count(as=total_events)])
    | match(file="admin_event_stats", field=[user.name], strict=false)
    | threshold := hourly_average_event_count + (3 * hourly_stddev_event_count)
    | case {
        threshold!=* | threshold := "0"; // User not in baseline.
        *;    
    }
    | test(total_events>threshold)
